notes: Documents are written by flink-aggregation-job with _id = MetricAggregate.documentId() — idempotent upserts make the at-least-once sink effectively-once.
dimensions uses 'flattened' so producer-controlled tag keys can NEVER explode the mapping (TECH-NOTES 3.6.5). On AWS OpenSearch rename the type to 'flat_object'.
dynamic:false — unknown fields are stored in _source but never mapped.
priority 200: stock ES 8 ships a built-in 'metrics' template (metrics-*-*) at priority 100 — equal priorities on overlapping patterns are rejected.
